plugins.name: fulcrum-sidekicks
plugins.description: Practical workflow skills for the Fulcrum suite.

plugins.name: fulcrum-pa-core
plugins.description: Personal-assistant skills for any business owner: daily briefings, scheduling, meeting prep, lead capture, pipeline review, outbound call campaigns, invoice chasing, quotes, outreach compliance, review replies and turning a process into a new skill.

plugins.name: fulcrum-property
plugins.description: Real estate and property management skills: open-home follow-up, weekly vendor reports, lease-against-billing checks and tenancy issue triage.

plugins.name: fulcrum-hospitality
plugins.description: Restaurant, venue and accommodation skills: reservations, function and catering quotes, guest stay communications and hospitality prospect research.

plugins.name: fulcrum-care-workforce
plugins.description: NDIS practice administration, care rostering and clinic skills: participant onboarding packs, progress notes, billing reconciliation, roster planning and appointment reminders.

plugins.name: fulcrum-trades-field
plugins.description: Trades, construction and automotive skills: job confirmations and dispatch, takeoff-to-quote with stock checks, workshop job cards and site daily reports.

plugins.name: fulcrum-professional-services
plugins.description: Professional services skills: client engagement setup with WIP checks, insurance renewal campaigns and two-sided recruitment pipelines.

plugins.name: fulcrum-web-builder
plugins.description: Website and UX/UI skills: Next.js and Tailwind v4 landing pages, design tokens, WCAG 2.2 AA audits, SEO and structured data, Core Web Vitals, conversion copy, responsive QA, UX critique and an anti-AI-slop design review.

metadata.description: Fulcrum Sidekick skills: reusable procedures that teach an AI teammate how to run everyday business work, industry workflows and website builds, with approval gates and verification.
